Andy Burnham Declared UK Labour Leader, Set to Become Prime Minister

Andy Burnham has been declared the leader of the UK's Labour Party and is expected to become the country's next Prime Minister. His appointment follows a leadership contest within the party. As he prepares to take office, reports indicate he faces significant policy decisions and potential challenges, including a backlash over plans to scrap the technology department and considerations for energy bill reforms.
